description: This file is a shell script for managing firmware upgrades on I-O DATA devices manufactured by MSTC. It includes functions for preparing the device environment, handling boot flags, and enabling debug modes, specifically for devices with certain partition structures.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure scenarios during environment preparation by notifying the user, unmounting all filesystems, and performing a forced reboot.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for an upgrade by checking and setting boot and debug flags in specific memory partitions based on provided offset.
